column1: # Sample inputs that still do not produce a usable run, verified with the master
# build at commit 260f6e2 (Apple M5, Apple clang 21, -O3, seed 20260810, nItr
# 1000) and re-checked on nerdss-optimized at 6b01636.
# They are kept out of cases.tsv because a crashed or hung run produces truncated
# output whose hash depends on where it stopped, which would make the bitwise
# comparison meaningless rather than informative.
# Neither row below is caused by the nerdss-optimized changes, though 459bd83
# changed how the first one fails.  Reproduce either by moving the row into
# cases.tsv and running:
#   CASE_TIMEOUT=60 SUITE_NITR=1000 ./run_suite.sh <binary> probe 1
# Three rows have left this table because nerdss-optimized fixed them, and all
# three were one defect: a molecule destroyed mid-timestep keeps its slot in
# moleculeList with myComIndex -1, and a loop that did not skip it indexed
# complexList[-1], one Complex before the vector's storage.
#   create_destroy  394fdd1, the overlap loop
#   clock_model     52b9ab3, the creation reactant pool
#   compartment     394fdd1, and 6b01636 for a transmitted molecule's partners
# The probe above runs all three to completion on 6b01636 with no
# AddressSanitizer report, and each was checked further: create_destroy over its
# full 60000 iterations, settling at 6036 A against an analytic steady state of
# 6022; clock_model over 200000 iterations on seeds 20260810 and 1-5; compartment
# over its full 100000 on the same seeds.  Under AddressSanitizer the pre-fix
# binary (207e22d) stops compartment at nerdss.cpp:1303 reading 100 bytes before
# complexList's storage, around step 8000, which is where the 8000-to-12000
# window this table used to record came from.  compartment is in
# coverage_cases.tsv; create_destroy and clock_model are in no table yet.
# id <TAB> input directory <TAB> parm file <TAB> failure
unimolecular_reverse
column4: No bimolecular association reaction, so set_rMaxLimit() leaves rMaxLimit at 0 and the simulation volume cannot be divided into sub-volumes. On master, SimulVolume::Dimensions divides the box length by it, the cell count goes negative and the run prints "CELL PAIR MAX EXCEEDED / Current number of cells: -4" indefinitely (~110M messages in 30 s) without advancing. Since 459bd83 nerdss-optimized detects it during setup and exits 1 naming the reason. The model still cannot run either way.

column4: Runs correctly, but the model holds a single molecule (A:1) so no reaction path is exercised. Excluded as a benchmark, not as a failure.
